objective: One shared model for one or more real simultaneous views; no duplicated or padded fake views

view_sampling.subset_and_order: deterministic random sample without replacement before encoder
view_sampling.source_split: retain original train/validation source groups; no viewed development scenes enter training

batching: equal view-count/resolution buckets, or independent ragged forwards; no attention padding yet
normalization: explicit scene/session scale fixed across subsets, with native-unit provenance
cache: separate encoder cache for exact RGB, view subset, order, preprocessing and encoder hash

losses.single_view_3d: no triangulation; learned metric joint lifting remains a separate unimplemented path
losses.reduction: per-scene means before averaging independent ragged scenes

evaluation.budget: report updates, images, encoder tokens and GPU time separately
evaluation.deployment: no automatic promotion from shape/smoke tests
